question: How do you ensure your code is secure?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with early-career experience
description: Behavioural interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: I follow OWASP guidelines, validate all inputs, use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection, and implement proper authentication/authorization. In my project, I added rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks and used helmet.js for security headers. I also keep dependencies updated and run security audits.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
Focusing on process without mentioning personal contribution
Failing to connect to the target role
evaluationCriteria: Clarity, security, specific examples, measurable outcomes
followUpQuestions: How does this apply to the Track-A role?
Can you provide more specific examples?
What would you do differently next time?
